result.title: Queue-Aware Token Communications: Bridging AI Representation and Wireless Service
result.summary: The rapid advancement of foundation models and edge intelligence is transforming wireless networks from data-oriented communication systems into artificial intelligence (AI)-native service platforms. Token communications (TokenCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm that directly transmits task-oriented AI representations. However, existing studies typically assume that generated tokens can be transmitted immediately, overlooking the queueing dynamics arising from the mismatch between token workload generation and time-varying wireless service capability. To address this limitation, we introduce Queue-Aware TokenCom, which explicitly incorporates token queues into the AI service pipeline. We present an end-to-end architecture integrating AI representation generation, token workload management, wireless transmission, and downstream task inference. We then discuss two key design directions: budget-aware token representation optimization and queue-aware token service optimization, with the token budget serving as a critical interface between AI performance and communication efficiency. Moreover, we investigate fixed and adaptive token budget strategies to characterize the fundamental tradeoff between AI performance and communication efficiency in dynamic wireless environments. Finally, we outline research directions toward closed-loop, task-aware, and scalable TokenCom systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Queue-Aware TokenCom，把 token 队列纳入 AI 服务链路，讨论预算感知的 token 表示优化与队列感知的服务优化，并比较固定与自适应 token 预算在 AI 性能与通信效率间的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究聚焦无线链路中 token 的排队与传输调度，未涉及视觉/多模态推理的内部状态、latent 生成或证据使用；其 token 预算指通信资源而非推理计算分配，与 LVR 主线无实质联系，也未见可迁移的方法线索。
